name: Solopreneur dashboard
description:
**Summary**

1. You asked for a `/solopreneur` solopreneur-mode view: analyze the attached mockups, produce a structure/components/functionality document plus an implementation proposal, and build a matching mockup.
2. I explored the repo (Vue 3 + Vuex/typed-vuex + DaisyUI/Tailwind 4, single catch-all route `/*` → `DesktopView`) and mapped the shell (sidebar + topbar) and seven cards (Account, Wallet, At a glance, Projects, Tasks, Updates, Messages, Calendar).
3. I proposed a mock REST contract (`/api/solopreneur/summary|account|projects|wallet|updates|messages`) and created `mockups/solopreneur.html` plus `wiki/solopreneur-view.md`.
4. You reported the mockup was broken (the first file was truncated mid-script); I rewrote `mockups/solopreneur.html` as a complete self-contained file with inline mock data, an in-script fake API, hash routing, i18n (EN/ES/FR), modals, toasts, and a dev panel.
5. The mockup now renders standalone with no external dependencies — open it in a browser at `#/solopreneur/summary` to review before porting to Vue components.
